name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused exclusively on precious metal assets in Nevada, one of the world's premier gold-mining jurisdictions. The company acquires net smelter royalties and exploration streams on producing, pre-production, and pre-resource properties, aggregating them into a diversified portfolio with low operating overhead. Nevada Canyon holds a 3% NSR and an Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement on the Lapon Canyon Project, where a 2025 reverse circulation drill program is underway.
